title: hardcoded user_id=1 in production paths
description:
Production code passes literal 1 as user_id parameter to list_subscribed(), handle_mailbox_set(), and handle_keyword_update(). This is a correctness bomb: a typo (e.g. 2 instead of 1) would silently route operations to wrong user. Must be defined as a constant (e.g. const SINGLETON_USER_ID: i64 = 1) and used throughout.

Affected locations:
- crates/mail/src/server.rs:441 list_subscribed(1)
- crates/mail/src/server.rs:506 handle_mailbox_set(..., 1, ...)
- crates/mail/src/server.rs:756 handle_keyword_update(..., 1, ...)

All calls to these functions pass 1 as user_id: grep -rn 'list_subscribed(1)\|handle_mailbox_set.*1\|handle_keyword_update.*1' crates/mail/src/server.rs
